description: This file implements the SerialPort class and related functionality for serial communication, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, as well as a SerialMonitor class for monitoring serial ports on Windows.

classes.name: SerialMonitor
classes.description: A class for monitoring serial ports on Windows, managing event-based notifications for serial port I/O.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: A class for managing serial port communication, supporting platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.
